rights.page_intro: General information about the materials on this page and rights relating to the protection of personal data.
rights.copyright_body: The software, code, interface elements and materials made available on this page may be protected by copyright and computer-program laws. Access to the system does not transfer intellectual-property rights. Reproduction, distribution, modification or commercial exploitation is subject to applicable rights and licenses, except for uses permitted by law.
rights.material_body: Third-party trademarks, images and content belong to their respective rights holders and may be subject to their own terms of use.
rights.privacy_body: Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law No. 13,709/2018) provides rights to individuals whose personal data is processed. The processing methods, purposes, legal bases, retention periods and sharing depend on each operation and the organization responsible for it.
rights.page_disclaimer: This page provides general information. It does not replace the privacy notice of the condominium, association or other organization using the system, and it does not by itself determine who acts as controller or processor for any particular processing activity.
rights.controller_body: To exercise rights concerning data processed by a condominium or association, first contact its administration or the organization that informed you about the collection and ask for the responsible controller's official channel. If you do not know which organization is responsible, ask the administration to identify it. This page does not collect requests or publish a data-protection contact.
rights.security_note: For your security, do not send passwords, access codes, tokens or identity documents through this page. Use only official channels provided by the responsible organization.
rights.data_subject_intro: Under the LGPD, as applicable to the processing, an individual may ask the controller for:
rights.item_fundamental: The LGPD recognizes individuals' ownership of their personal data and fundamental rights to freedom, intimacy and privacy.
rights.item_confirmation: Confirmation that personal data is being processed and access to their own data.
rights.item_correction: Correction of incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data.
rights.item_anonymize: Anonymization, blocking or deletion of data that is unnecessary, excessive or processed contrary to law.
rights.item_portability: Data portability, subject to ANPD regulations and legal limits, including trade and industrial secrets.
rights.item_consent: Deletion of data processed on the basis of consent, subject to legal retention exceptions.
rights.item_sharing: Information about public or private entities with which data has been shared.
rights.item_consent_refusal: Information about the option and consequences of withholding consent, and its withdrawal when consent is the applicable legal basis.
rights.item_opposition: The right to object to processing carried out without consent when it violates the LGPD, under the conditions set by law.
rights.item_automated: Review of decisions based solely on automated processing that affect the individual's interests, where applicable.
rights.item_petition: The right to petition the ANPD about one's data and, where applicable, consumer-protection bodies.
rights.exercise_body: Requests should be sent to the controller or a legally appointed representative. The controller may take reasonable steps to verify the requester's identity and protect data from unauthorized access. Exercising statutory rights is free of charge, subject to applicable legal rules for each request.
rights.response_formats: For confirmation of processing or access, Article 19 of the LGPD provides for a simplified response immediately, or a clear and complete statement within 15 days, subject to applicable rules and regulations.
